firstPlayerRule: The player who chirps the loudest starts the first round.
clarifications: The player who passed last in round one starts round two. Players take turns clockwise during each round.
internalEvidence: The publisher's updated downloads page links this English rulebook. Rendered page 3, setup step 5, selects the loudest chirper. Page 4 confirms clockwise turns, and page 10 assigns the second-round start to the player who passed last in round one.
